Experiment: MOSCOW Method – Library Management System

Aim:
To categorize the requirements of a Library Management System using the MOSCOW prioritization method based on user/stakeholder impact, feasibility, time, budget, and available resources.

Requirements to enter in Google Sheets/Excel:

S.NoRequirementMOSCOW CategoryJustification
1Search books by title and authorMust-HaveCore functionality with high user impact and easy database implementation.
2Online book reservation systemMust-HaveImportant for users and feasible within normal project resources.
3Monthly reports on borrowed booksMust-HaveImportant for administrators and easy to generate from existing data.
4Email notifications for overdue booksShould-HaveUseful for reducing overdue books; requires email-service integration.
5QR code scanning for borrowing/returningShould-HaveSpeeds up librarian operations but needs additional device/integration support.
6User-friendly librarian dashboardMust-HaveEssential for managing daily library activities and feasible with standard UI tools.
7User reviews and ratingsCould-HaveImproves user engagement but is not essential for core library functions.
8Chatbot for user assistanceCould-HaveHelpful for user support but requires additional AI/NLP resources.
9Mobile app versionWon't-Have (Now)High development time and cost; can be added in a future version.
10Multi-language supportWon't-Have (Now)Useful for accessibility but requires additional translation and development effort.

Procedure

  1. Open Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel.

  2. Create a new spreadsheet.

  3. Enter the title “MOSCOW Prioritization for Library Management System”.

  4. Create columns:

    • S.No.

    • Requirement

    • Description

    • MOSCOW Category

    • Justification

  5. Enter all 10 requirements.

  6. Analyze each requirement based on impact and feasibility.

  7. Assign Must-Have, Should-Have, Could-Have, or Won't-Have.

  8. Add justification for every category.

  9. Format the categories with different colors.

  10. Save the file as Library_Management_MOSCOW_Analysis.xlsx.

Screenshot for your experiment: the image above is designed to look like the Google Sheets screen while doing the experiment.
